title: No automated test pins demo-CTA absence on /tools/*, /resources, /resources/:slug
evidence:
+- Given `/tools/*`, `/resources`, and `/resources/:slug` pages, when rendered, then no demo CTA is present
+// surface. /tools/*, /resources and rent-post pages are deliberately out of
+// scope (one primary CTA per view).
detail: Spec acceptance requires absence on non-guide pages, but the diff adds no test asserting it — only a manual curl documented in the spec. A future composition adding the CTA outside /guides would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add a test rendering a tools/resources/rent-post view asserting data-testid="guide-demo-cta" is absent.

title: New test calls three render helpers not defined in this diff
detail: The diff defines 8 helpers but the test list also calls these 3, which must pre-exist in content_test.gleam. Unverifiable from the diff alone; if absent, the test suite fails to compile.
recommended_fix: Confirm the three helpers already exist in content_test.gleam; otherwise define them in this change.

title: Bare attribute(...) constructor used with no import change in layout.gleam
detail: Module-access calls like attribute.class need only `import lustre/attribute`; the bare `attribute(name, value)` constructor form additionally needs the braced import. The diff adds no import line; the spec merely claims one pre-exists.
recommended_fix: Verify layout.gleam's import line brings the bare `attribute` constructor into scope; add it if missing.

title: guide_demo_cta doc comment misdescribes placement on rtb_disputes and property_management_fees
evidence:
+/// placed directly under the guide's closing signup CTA (`inline_cta`) where
+/// one exists, otherwise at the end of the page content (part-4-tenancy, whose
+/// primary CTA sits mid-page).
detail: The comment's taxonomy (under a closing CTA, else end of page) matches neither rtb_disputes nor property_management_fees, where the block lands mid-page with view_faq/view_sources following it.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to the actual rule: immediately after view_cta() wherever it appears; end-of-content placement only for part-4-tenancy.
